claims.sourceText: WikiLeaks, The Podesta Emails, email id 3099, https://wikileaks.org/podesta-emails/emailid/3099
claims.text: In the same email DeLonge told Podesta the general was not the sceptic he had been described as: 'I've been working with him for four months. I just got done giving him a four hour presentation on the entire project a few weeks ago', and that 'He not only knows what I'm trying to achieve, he helped assemble my advisory team.'

claims.nodeLabel: DeLonge to Podesta, 'General McCasland', 25 January 2016 (WikiLeaks Podesta Emails 3099)
claims.sourceText: WikiLeaks, The Podesta Emails, email id 3099, released 10 October 2016, https://wikileaks.org/podesta-emails/emailid/3099
claims.text: DeLonge wrote to Podesta on 25 January 2016 under the subject 'General McCasland': 'When Roswell crashed, they shipped it to the laboratory at Wright Patterson Air Force Base. General McCasland was in charge of that exact laboratory up to a couple years ago.' The raw source gives the date as Mon, 25 Jan 2016 10:04:29 -0800 and the message id as E8428167-CF1B-4CC3-95D2-977A277CC5CB@me.com.

a.label: DeLonge to Podesta, 'General McCasland', 25 January 2016 (WikiLeaks Podesta Emails 3099)

edges.label: Subject of the email and party to the meeting thread, as 'General McCasland' and 'Neil McCasland'
edges.note: The email names General McCasland and the meeting thread runs through [a personal Gmail address], signing 'Neil McC'. The email gives no rank, service or middle name, so the identification with the board's William Neil McCasland rests on the name and on the node's own Air Force biography, not on the email.

a.label: DeLonge to Podesta, 'General McCasland', 25 January 2016 (WikiLeaks Podesta Emails 3099)

edges.label: DeLonge's written assertion that the Roswell material went to the Wright-Patterson laboratory
edges.note: The email asserts to Podesta that 'When Roswell crashed, they shipped it to the laboratory at Wright Patterson Air Force Base' and that the general ran that laboratory until a couple of years earlier. The record establishes that DeLonge asserted this in writing in January 2016, not that it happened.
